author: jeffspahr
methodology: Primary purpose is an editorial classification based on title, description, and changed paths; one category per PR, rather than GitHub labels. Backports and superseded PRs count separately.
Security & dependency maintenance includes ordinary dependency upkeep and automation, not only vulnerability fixes. Major UI migrations and React/UX modernization are Frontend.
Test-only frontend modernization stays Frontend; shared CI, E2E infrastructure, flake control and build/test lanes are CI.
Explicit release orchestration, upgrade migration, data transfer and compatibility rollbacks are Releases; security backports stay Security.
13562 and 13577 are Security because descriptions link bounded streaming fixes to ADA-KUBEFL audit findings.
15044 and 15045 are compatibility rollbacks, not security remediation; classified Releases.
14888 is a closed placeholder with body describing pre-commit Go test naming repairs; classified CI.
15286 is defensive nil-request validation; classified Backend rather than assuming an unclaimed vulnerability.
